devicedata.name: moenshower
devicedata.templatedescription: Moen Smart Shower (U by Moen) - Local TCP bridge or direct cloud control, custom Navigator web view and keypad preset keys (v306)

event.name: Shower Started
event.description: NAME: the shower turned on (any mode other than off)

event.name: Shower Ready
event.description: NAME: the water reached the target temperature

command.name: Shower On
command.description: Turn the shower on (resumes the active preset if one is paused, otherwise a plain on with no preset)

command.name: Set Temperature
command.description: Set the target temperature (F) while the shower is running

command.name: Activate Preset
command.description: Activate a saved Moen shower preset by its position number

command.name: Resume Paused Shower
command.description: Resume water flow after a preset paused it at temperature (mode = paused-by-preset)

command.name: Refresh Status
command.description: Poll Moen's cloud immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled poll

command.name: Set Outlet
command.description: Turn a single outlet on/off directly (bypasses presets)
